profile.headline: Software Developer @ Paycom
profile.summary:
As a recent graduate with a B.S. in Electrical Engineering and a Software Developer at Paycom, I am a results-driven professional with a strong foundation in software development and a passion for leveraging technology to create meaningful solutions. My academic journey at the University of Oklahoma, coupled with hands-on experiences at Texas Instruments, Samsung Semiconductor, and ExxonMobil, has equipped me with a diverse skill set in languages like PHP, MySQL, Python, C#, HTML, SQL, and JavaScript.

In my role at Paycom, I am actively driving high-paced software development for both internal and external projects, emphasizing optimal performance through effective communication and organizational skills. My commitment to excellence is reflected in my ability to adapt and thrive in dynamic environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-wide services and interfacing technologies.

Beyond my technical expertise, I am dedicated to community engagement, having been an active member of service-based organizations like Latinos Without Borders and Sigma Lambda Gamma National Sorority, Inc. These experiences have not only shaped my character but also strengthened my ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams.

I am excited about the journey ahead and how my strategic mindset, attention to detail, and passion for innovation will contribute to the success of impactful projects. Thank you for taking the time to learn more about me. I'm always open to new opportunities and collaborations, so feel free to reach out and connect.

positions.title: Software Developer IV
positions.description:
Driving high-paced software development for both internal and external projects, placing a strong emphasis on achieving optimal performance through effective communication, organizational skills, and industry knowledge.

Collaborating extensively with cross-functional internal teams to ensure adherence to organizational processes and align development efforts with business objectives. Facilitated clear communication between Development, QA, and Project Managers, addressing system issues proactively and optimizing workflows for timely project delivery.

Engaging in software development across various projects, encompassing industry-wide services, and interfacing technologies. Utilizing technologies like PHP, C#, MySQL, Docker, Git to drive innovation and efficiency across software solutions.

positions.title: Applications Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed a Python automation program to create remote communication with bench equipment, reducing validation process time and increasing support efficiency.

Implemented JIRA for project visibility, to better determine request priority, and reduce email traffic.

Provided support to technical customers by bettering my battery charger fundamental knowledge,
answering over 126 questions and driving customer-facing support.

positions.title: Test Technology Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed a User Management Interface that allowed engineers and technicians access to an Emergency Line Shutdown Interface used to remotely recover wafers during an emergency event.

Further developed my coding skills in the following languages: C#, HTML, SQL, JavaScript, Git & GitHub.

Gained tremendous industry as well as semiconductor knowledge by utilizing my problem-solving and
communication skills.

positions.title: Instrumentation & Controls Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Utilized Abnormal Event Detection – Real-Time Advisory (AED-RTA) to determine abnormal events and identify failures in advance for electrical equipment at the Shute Creek Treatment Facility in LaBarge, Wyoming.

Promoted innovation by seeking opportunities to broaden surveillance across various pieces of equipment at the facility.

Created clarity by raising awareness of potential incidents and increasing knowledge of equipment operation.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Promoting the success of Hispanics in the engineering community by providing crucial resources for the Latino community as well as promoting academic excellence, community, and leadership skills.

•	SHPE also provides great resources and conferences that empower the Hispanic community and bridges the gap between Hispanics and STEM. Conferences have benefited me in through developing both my professional skills, and social skills.

•	The goal and purpose of LWB is to empower and provide resources to the Latinx community.
 
•	Family Leaders serve as counselors and mentors, they develop close relationships with campers and conference attendees to provide resources on the feasibility of higher education.
